# Sidebar

The side navigation of an app, open while people work.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> Sidebar is app navigation, not a website's main navigation. Content first is a public site; navigation menu carries the site sections and sheet the phone menu. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./navigation-menu">Navigation menu</a>, <a href="./sheet">Sheet</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Apps with several sections people move between all session.
- **Not when:** A website's main navigation (navigation menu), or a few sections that fit in tabs.

Instead:

- [Navigation menu](./navigation-menu.md): Website navigation.
- [Tabs](./tabs.md): Views of one thing.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a navigation landmark; the current section is marked; collapsing keeps names for icons. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add sidebar
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
